title: Chain Merge Belt
description:
## Task

Numbered crates arrive one at a time on a belt and are added to the end of a row. As soon as the last two crates in the row have the same number, they fuse into a single crate carrying their sum, and that new crate is checked against the one before it in the same way, so a chain of fusions can follow. Keep going until the row stops changing, then add the next arriving crate. Return the final row after every crate has arrived.

## Input

- `crates` — a list of positive integers in arrival order. It may be empty.

## Output

The list of crate numbers in the final row, from first to last.

## Example

```python
chain_merge_belt([2, 2, 4, 8])  # returns [16]
chain_merge_belt([1, 2, 2, 1])  # returns [1, 4, 1]
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `crates` ≤ 10^5
- 1 ≤ each number ≤ 1000
